decks.notes: The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes cards like Absorb, Dovin's Veto, and Supreme Verdict to stop opponents' threats, while also using spells like Jwari Disruption and Memory Deluge to maintain card advantage. The deck also includes permanents like Omen of the Sea and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to generate additional card advantage and provide flexibility. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and blinking of key permanents. The mana base is built with a mix of utility lands and dual lands to ensure consistency.

The focus of this deck is on utilizing counterspells and removal spells to control the game, while also utilizing card advantage and creating threats through planeswalkers and tokens. The deck aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan until it can establish a dominant position and close out the game. The inclusion of various lands to fix mana and provide utility, along with a mix of instant speed and sorcery speed spells, gives the deck flexibility in handling different threats and situations. The key strategy is to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly generate a large amount of mana using cards like Lotus Field and Arboreal Grazer, and then use that mana to combo off and win the game. The deck includes cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to untap Lotus Field and generate even more mana. It also includes cards like Emergent Ultimatum and Dark Petition to search for and play important combo pieces, such as Omniscience and Chandra, Hope's Beacon. This deck focuses on executing its combo as quickly and efficiently as possible.

The deck focuses on leveraging the power of spirits to apply constant pressure on opponents and control the tempo of the game. By utilizing flying creatures and disruption spells, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and protect them with counterspells. The inclusion of cards like Curious Obsession and Mausoleum Wanderer can help maintain card advantage and disrupt opponents' strategies. The use of snow-covered lands and Faceless Haven adds versatility and resilience to the deck's mana base. Overall, the deck prioritizes aggressive plays while maintaining control over the battlefield.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly swarm the board with aggressive creatures like Knight-Errant of Eos, Burning-Tree Emissary, and Venerated Loxodon, while using cards like Embercleave and Reckless Bushwhacker to pump up your creatures and deal massive damage to your opponent. Legion's Landing helps generate extra tokens, while cards like Gleeful Demolition and Giant Killer provide removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful offensive strategy, utilizing a mix of creatures and spells to secure victory.

This deck revolves around the concept of combining cards that allow for creativity in manipulating the game state. The main focus is on obtaining powerful effects by utilizing the interaction between Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity. Additionally, the deck includes a suite of control and removal options, such as Fiery Impulse, Magma Opus, and Spikefield Hazard. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hall of Storm Giants. Overall, the deck aims to create explosive and unexpected plays through its combination of combo-centric cards and versatile spells.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by utilizing a combination of hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, removal spells like Fatal Push and Bloodchief's Thirst, and powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Archfiend of the Dross to control the game. The deck also includes cards like Phyrexian Arena and Liliana of the Veil to generate card advantage and maintain control over the battlefield. The key concept of this deck is to outvalue and outlast the opponent by controlling the game through a combination of disruption, removal, and powerful threats.

This deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents by utilizing the powerful abilities of Niv-Mizzet Reborn. By playing a diverse array of multicolored cards, the deck is able to consistently draw cards and answer threats through a toolbox of spells. The inclusion of Bring to Light allows for flexibility in finding key cards, while the companion Yorion provides additional value through blinking permanents. The deck also features strong removal options and a variety of lands to ensure mana consistency.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and board wipes. It aims to outvalue the opponent by drawing extra cards with card advantage engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by blinking permanents for more ETB effects. The mana base is designed to support the three-color combination of white, black, and blue, while also having lands that can come into play untapped for optimal tempo. The deck overall aims to grind out the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II combo to create a powerful synergy that enables quick victories. To support this combo, the deck includes cards like Raffine's Informant, Esika's Chariot, and Witherbloom Command to provide additional support and options. The inclusion of Thoughtseize and Duress helps to disrupt opponents' strategies, while cards like Grisly Salvage and Vessel of Nascency aid in card advantage and deck thinning. Liliana of the Veil offers removal options, while the mana base is designed to support the deck's objectives efficiently.

The deck focuses on using Neoform to tutor for specific creatures such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier, gaining value from its proliferate ability. It includes cards like Tasigur, the Golden Fang and Hooting Mandrills to provide additional threats and disruption. The deck also includes a variety of disruptive spells like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Stubborn Denial to control the board and protect your combo pieces. With Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to apply constant pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures and removal spells, while also disrupting their game plan with hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize. The deck aims to control the board and maintain a fast pace to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Additionally, it utilizes the graveyard with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to gain an advantage over the opponent. The land base includes a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent mana production and the ability to adapt to different situations.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent early in the game with efficient creatures and removal spells. Utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal damage while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also aims to take advantage of graveyard interactions with Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Graveyard Trespasser. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse can provide a powerful late-game threat while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Reckoner Bankbuster help maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on using sacrifice synergies to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Witch's Oven and Cauldron Familiar to generate incremental advantage, while also incorporating Claim the Firstborn to steal opposing creatures. With efficient removal like Fatal Push and a strong finisher in Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of sacrificial interactions to secure victory. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's gameplan.

This deck focuses on building a strong board presence of low-cost creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck can quickly pump up its creatures and deal significant damage early in the game. The inclusion of Ossification helps protect key creatures from removal spells, while cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Brutal Cathar provide additional support and utility. With a mix of creature pump spells and aggressive weenies, this deck aims to pressure the opponent and win through fast, aggressive plays.

The main goal of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By playing low-cost creatures like Hopeful Initiate and Coppercoat Vanguard, combined with powerful anthem effects from Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck can quickly build a strong board presence. Additionally, the inclusion of protective spells like Brave the Elements and Dauntless Bodyguard help to keep your creatures safe from removal. With a mix of creature buffs and protection, this deck aims to outpace and outlast the opponent through relentless aggression.
